verdict.rationale: Devin's core interface is conversational/natural-language: docs describe tasking Devin via chat, Slack/Teams tagging, CLI natural-language prompts, and Ask Devin queries — all in plain language rather than rigid commands. Community evidence corroborates hands-on use of natural-language task assignment, though it flags reliability issues with scope creep, not with the natural-language interface itself. Missing for 10: independent verification of complex multi-step NL command handling and clearer resolution of the 'ask for help' escape hatch inconsistency noted in community reports.
